questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of career planning as described in the chapter?

options.text: To secure the highest-paying job immediately after graduation
To design a professional journey that aligns with personal values, interests, and long-term aspirations
To follow the career path chosen by family or peers
To avoid changing jobs or industries in the future

correct_answer.text: To design a professional journey that aligns with personal values, interests, and long-term aspirations

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT a key component of the career planning process outlined in Section 2?

options.text: Self-Assessment
Goal Setting
Immediate Job Placement
Review and Adjust

questions.question_text: Why is self-awareness considered the foundation of career planning in Section 3?

options.text: It guarantees a high salary in your chosen field
It helps you understand your strengths, passions, and values to choose a fitting career path
It ensures you avoid any career changes in the future
It eliminates the need for research or informed decision-making

correct_answer.text: It helps you understand your strengths, passions, and values to choose a fitting career path

questions.question_text: According to Section 4, which common myth about career planning is debunked with the idea that careers can evolve over time?

options.text: “A High-Paying Job Equals Success”
“You Must Choose One Career for Life”
“Career Planning Is Only for ‘Serious’ or ‘Ambitious’ People”
“You Need a College Degree for a Good Career”

correct_answer.text: “You Must Choose One Career for Life”

questions.question_text: In the activity “Defining Personal Career Success” from Section 5, what is the main goal for participants?

options.text: To compare their career goals with peers for competition
To define success based on societal standards like salary or job title
To create a personal vision of career success that reflects individual values and aspirations
To finalize a permanent career path without future adjustments

correct_answer.text: To create a personal vision of career success that reflects individual values and aspirations

questions.question_text: What is a key benefit of informed decision-making in career planning, as discussed in Section 3?

options.text: It guarantees immediate job offers without effort
It prevents wasting time on paths that don’t match reality or personal goals through research and facts
It eliminates the need for self-awareness or reflection
It ensures you will never face career challenges or setbacks

correct_answer.text: It prevents wasting time on paths that don’t match reality or personal goals through research and facts
